title: Exploring Shenzhen’s Dafen Oil Painting Village
description: Xiaotong Li visited Dafen Village, a unique Shenzhen enclave where art and livelihood intertwine. Watch artisans recreate masterpieces, craft original works, and blend creativity with commerce. From vibrant alleys to quirky stores, see how dreams and reality merge in this artistic haven. 🎨✨
